## Tata Pricing Updates

Pricing depends on the Tata entity and service line, but enterprise technology contracts commonly use managed service, fixed bid, time-and-materials, or outcome-based models.

## Key Price Changes
- IT services: Rates vary by skill mix, geography, and delivery model
- Managed services: Multi-year commitments can improve discounts but reduce flexibility
- Network services: Pricing depends on bandwidth, geography, SLAs, and redundancy needs

## Business Impact
- Scope clarity is the main lever for avoiding change-request cost growth
- Offshore delivery can reduce run-rate costs when governance is mature
- Outcome pricing can align incentives but requires measurable KPIs

## What This Means
- Define legal entity and service scope before commercial negotiation
- Benchmark rate cards against peer Indian IT services providers
- Include productivity commitments and transformation milestones
